description: Fetch one of the 118 curated templates together with its full design config (module and finder shapes, colours, frame, caption). Use it when the user liked a template but wants changes: read the config here, then pass it to qr_generate with their tweaks. qr_generate_from_template renders the template as-is.

templateId.description: Template id from qr_list_templates. Numeric or slug, e.g. "luxury-gold".

name: qr_get_template

config.description: The engine QrConfig for this template: the same fields qr_generate accepts, so it can be tweaked and re-rendered.

title: Read a curated template's design
